findings.message: Requirement coverage: R2 is covered. divide(8,2)=4 and division by zero throws, by source inspection of autodev-probe/app.mjs. Runtime pass is not inferred from source. Sonnet real verification must still run R2-test and R2-api against the current product hash.

The R2-api check starts an HTTP server whose handler only returns add() and greet() results. It never calls divide(), so the HTTP evidence says nothing about R2. The only R2 evidence is the direct assertion in the test and api runs. This is a limit of the shared adapter, not a defect in the R2 product.
divide only guards b===0. Non-numeric or NaN denominators are not rejected. The requirement does not demand this, so it is only an observation.
greet and clamp in app.mjs are unimplemented stubs, so R3 and R4 are not done. This is expected work for later tasks and does not affect the R2 verdict.
